decisions.reason: The accelerator program is still the furthest from the firm's core modular recycling machinery business, and management would now likely reallocate those resources to proprietary technology and new development.
Although it is commercially riskier than the equipment products, the CO2-negative binder has been positioned as a strategic flagship and fits the firm's innovation-led circular-economy direction.
The mobile mechanical recycling plant directly matches the firm's decentralized modular equipment strategy and core manufacturing strengths, so it is very likely to remain on the market.
